TIEBA_DIY_POWER_TIMES_TWO_POWER.descript: Whenever any creature applies a [gold]Power[/gold], double the amount applied.
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_ATROCITY_POWER.title: Atrocity
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_ATROCITY_POWER.descripti: At the start of your turn, apply {Amount} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_WILD_HUNT_DELAY_POWER.de: Tracks a death delayed by the Wild Hunt.
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_WORLD_OF_PILLARS_POWER.d: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], add {Amount} cards to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_HOT_START_POWER.title: Hot Start
TIEBA_DIY_POWER_HOT_START_POWER.descript: Whenever you [gold]Channel[/gold] an Orb, trigger its passive ability {Amount} times.
